messages:
Anya P: Quick sync — we need to firm up what goes into the observability "beta" we promise customers next quarter. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam R: +1. Customers keep asking for cost attribution by route and trace-level latency slicing.
Matt S: Agree on cost and traces. Also want a light-weight error analytics view (grouping by stack trace + request attributes) — but we should be careful with retention/ingest costs.
Liz C: From CS — two enterprise pilots (FinRegCo, MedAI) asked for: per-model cost breakdown, SLO dashboards, and a simple tracing hook to correlate errors with model versions. They want this in a pilot by week 6.
Dora G: Marketing also needs a clean story: "beta = meaningful visibility, not full coverage". We should avoid promising full trace sampling.
Anya P: Proposed minimal beta scope (MVP):
• Dashboards: SLOs (p99 latency, error rate), per-route throughput, token spend daily trend.
• Cost: per-route token spend + top-10 heavy routes, exportable CSV.
• Tracing hook: sampling hook + route-tagging, ability to attach model_version tag.
• Error analytics: grouped errors (first class key = exception message + model_version), rapid drilldown to example request.
Sam R: Looks good for MVP. Implementation note: tracing hook should be a single header we inject: X-RW-TraceKey and route tag. Avoid changing runtime core.
Matt S: Operational constraints: we can keep raw spans for 7 days, aggregate metrics for 30 days. If CS needs longer retention for pilots we can do exports to their S3.
Liz C: Pilot acceptance criteria from customers:
```
- Can see per-route token spend and filter by model_version
- Can correlate spikes in p99 with a model rollout in past 24h
- Can click an error group and see 5 example requests (redacted)
- CSV export of cost for billing reconciliation
```
Dora G: Prioritization thoughts: label this beta as "visibility-first" with clear limitations: sampling, retention, and no full top-to-bottom trace linking for GA.
Anya P: Tradeoffs:
- If we enable full sampling for all routes -> ops cost explodes.
- If we restrict sampling to flagged routes (canary + top N) -> misses some signals.
Which is the right default?
Sam R: Default = sample-on-error + adaptive sampling for routes > X qps. Keeps costs bounded and surfaces badness.
Matt S: We should add a config flag per-customer for sampling policy (pilot customers can escalate). Also add an automated fallback: when p99 > threshold, bump sampling for 1 hour.
Anya P: Timeline ask: can eng deliver MVP for internal beta in 5 sprints? If not, we need to cut one item.
Sam R: 5 sprints looks tight. My dev estimate: dashboards (2 sprints), cost breakdown pipeline (2 sprints), tracing hook + tagging (1 sprint), error grouping infra (2 sprints) -> 7 sprints. Could compress if we scope dashboards to templates (use existing widgets) and reuse metrics ingestion.
Liz C: If we must cut, keep cost CSV + ability to tag model_version. Customer impact > pretty dashboards.
Dora G: Marketing would accept a "template dashboard" MVP. We can surface it as "pre-built dashboards" for beta.
Anya P: Decision proposal: MVP = cost CSV + template SLO dashboard + tracing header + error grouping with 7d examples. Stretch for pilot = clickable drilldown to raw span + 30d retention exports.
Sam R: Agree. Action items:
- Sam: draft sampling policy config and header spec (due EOW)
- Matt: sketch retention/export plan and S3 export flow (due Tue)
- Anya: write beta acceptance checklist and customer comms (due Thu)
- Liz: confirm pilots (FinRegCo, MedAI) OK with proposed limits (due Thu)
infra-bot: deploybot: scheduled canary for obs-pipeline tomorrow 03:00 UTC; notify #eng-oncall on failure.
Liz C: Noted. I'll loop in FinRegCo legal for redaction checklist.
Anya P: One more ask — include a clear disclaimer in UI about sampling and retention. Dora, can marketing draft language?
Dora G: Yup. Short blurb + "learn more" doc. I’ll draft and share by Wed.
Sam R: Re: metrics wiring — we will reuse the existing metrics export endpoint and add per-route tags. Example header: `X-RW-Route: /v1/generate, X-RW-Model: redwood-7b`
Matt S: Also add model_version as structured tag (not free text) to allow aggregation.
Anya P: Ok locking this in. We'll treat clickable raw-span drilldown as a GA tie-breaker, not beta. Thanks all.
Sam R: +1
Liz C: +1
Dora G: +1 :rocket:
Matt S: +1 
Anya P: Meeting adjourned — I'll post the acceptance checklist after dinner.
